edits.text: Traditional 這 is analyzed with 言 as a phonetic component in the older verb use “meet/receive,” but no ancient reading pair establishes that proposed sound relation. The current Mandarin readings are yán for 言 and zhè for 這 and 这; they do not prove the historical analysis. [E5, E6, X-9a8d3fc9d3ca99811fb0, X-8162e2df6f7495ad174d, X-21cf60800e3e790528d5, X-03d3d036bf0a84610ec7]

An analysis assigns 言 a phonetic role in traditional 這 for the older verb use “meet/receive.” In Modern Mandarin, 言 is yán and 這 is zhè; this present-day comparison does not establish the proposed ancient sound relation. [E5, E6, X-9a8d3fc9d3ca99811fb0, X-8162e2df6f7495ad174d, X-03d3d036bf0a84610ec7]
